title: Second railroad with safe post-buy cash
description: Second railroad with safe post-buy cash. A second railroad doubles railroad rent and keeps a safe cash cushion. A shallow policy would choose start_auction; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.public_message: I will purchase the Pennsylvania Railroad.
final_action.private_thought: Buying the railroad for $200 strengthens my asset base and provides future rent income. I have ample cash ($690) and no railroads yet, so securing one is strategically sound.
